SELECT `agreement_status`,
 COUNT(*) AS agreements,
 SUM(`total_license_fee`) AS total_license_fee,
 SUM(CASE WHEN `agreement_status`='Active' AND `effective_date` > DATE'2026-11-10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS signed_not_yet_started,
 SUM(CASE WHEN `agreement_status`='Active' AND `expiry_date` < DATE'2026-11-10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_but_past_expiry,
 SUM(CASE WHEN `agreement_status`='Expired' AND `expiry_date` >= DATE'2026-11-10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_but_future_expiry,
 SUM(CASE WHEN `agreement_status`='Active' AND `expiry_date` BETWEEN DATE'2026-11-10' AND date_add(DATE'2026-11-10',30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expiring_30d,
 SUM(CASE WHEN `agreement_status`='Active' AND `expiry_date` BETWEEN DATE'2026-11-10' AND date_add(DATE'2026-11-10',90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expiring_90d,
 SUM(CASE WHEN `agreement_status`='Active' AND `expiry_date` BETWEEN DATE'2026-11-10' AND date_add(DATE'2026-11-10',90) THEN `total_license_fee` ELSE 0 END) AS fee_expiring_90d,
 ROUND(100*SUM(CASE WHEN `agreement_status`='Active' AND `expiry_date` BETWEEN DATE'2026-11-10' AND date_add(DATE'2026-11-10',90) THEN `total_license_fee` ELSE 0 END)/SUM(`total_license_fee`),1) AS pct_fee_expiring_90d,
 SUM(CASE WHEN `agreement_status`='Expired' AND `expiry_date` >= DATE'2026-05-10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_last_6m
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`license_agreement`
GROUP BY `agreement_status` ORDER BY `agreement_status`

WITH exp AS (
 SELECT a.`license_agreement_id`, a.`primary_license_holder_id`, a.`expiry_date`, a.`total_license_fee`, a.`exclusivity_flag`
 FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`license_agreement` a
 WHERE a.`agreement_status`='Active' AND a.`expiry_date` BETWEEN DATE'2026-11-10' AND date_add(DATE'2026-11-10',90)),
od AS (
 SELECT `license_agreement_id`, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(`net_royalty_amount`) AS amt
 FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`royalty_statement` WHERE `statement_status`='Overdue' GROUP BY `license_agreement_id`)
SELECT h.`rights_holder_name` AS licensor, COUNT(*) AS agreements_expiring_90d,
 SUM(CASE WHEN e.`expiry_date` <= date_add(DATE'2026-11-10',30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_30d,
 SUM(CASE WHEN e.`exclusivity_flag` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exclusive,
 MIN(e.`expiry_date`) AS first_expiry, SUM(e.`total_license_fee`) AS fee_expiring,
 COALESCE(SUM(od.n),0) AS overdue_royalty_statements, COALESCE(SUM(od.amt),0) AS overdue_net_royalty
FROM exp e JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`holder` h ON e.`primary_license_holder_id`=h.`holder_id`
LEFT JOIN od ON od.`license_agreement_id`=e.`license_agreement_id`
GROUP BY h.`rights_holder_name`
ORDER BY agreements_expiring_90d DESC, fee_expiring DESC

SELECT r.`statement_status`, COUNT(*) AS statements, COUNT(DISTINCT r.`license_agreement_id`) AS agreements, SUM(r.`net_royalty_amount`) AS net_royalty_usd,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.`agreement_status`='Active' THEN r.`net_royalty_amount` ELSE 0 END) AS net_on_active_agreements,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.`agreement_status`='Active' THEN r.`license_agreement_id` END) AS active_agreements,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.`agreement_status`='Active' AND a.`expiry_date` BETWEEN DATE'2026-11-10' AND date_add(DATE'2026-11-10',90) THEN r.`net_royalty_amount` ELSE 0 END) AS net_on_expiring_90d,
 SUM(CASE WHEN r.`statement_due_date` >= DATE'2026-05-10' THEN r.`net_royalty_amount` ELSE 0 END) AS net_due_last_6m,
 MIN(r.`statement_due_date`) AS earliest_due
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`royalty_statement` r
LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`license_agreement` a ON r.`license_agreement_id`=a.`license_agreement_id`
GROUP BY r.`statement_status` ORDER BY statements DESC

SELECT h.`rights_holder_name` AS licensor, COUNT(*) AS overdue_statements, SUM(r.`net_royalty_amount`) AS overdue_net_royalty, MIN(r.`statement_due_date`) AS oldest_due_date
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`royalty_statement` r
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`holder` h ON r.`holder_id` = h.`holder_id`
WHERE r.`statement_status` = 'Overdue'
GROUP BY h.`rights_holder_name` ORDER BY overdue_net_royalty DESC LIMIT 10
